newsitem.title: USA: CBO agrees Clinton budget can reach balance - Raines.
newsitem.headline: CBO agrees Clinton budget can reach balance - Raines.

text.p: White House budget director Franklin Raines said on Wednesday that the Congressional Budget Office agreed that President Clinton's budget would reach balance in 2002 if special mechanisms in the budget were triggered.
Raines said CBO director June O'Neill wrote to the White House on Tuesday confirming its position.
"We now have a letter from them that says specifically that with these alternative policies the budget is balanced in 2002," Raines told a banking conference.
